# Ivan Kovacevic - full site index (llms-full.txt)

> Official website of Serbian double bassist, bandleader and arranger Ivan Kovacevic
> (Belgrade 1977, based in Barcelona). Balkan, jazz and rhythm & blues. Complete citable
> index of the site for AI systems and search engines.

## Canonical site
- URL: https://ivankovacevic.com/
- Languages: en, ca, es, sr
- Sitemap: https://ivankovacevic.com/sitemap.xml
- Short summary: https://ivankovacevic.com/llms.txt
- Contact / booking: ivandoublebass@gmail.com

## EN (en)

### Biography
- Biography - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/biography/
  The musical career of double bassist Ivan Kovačević: from Belgrade to Barcelona, Balkan music, jazz and rhythm & blues.

### Projects
- Ivan Kovačević 5 Spots - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/projects/5-spots/
  There was a time when jazz was breathing fire, it smoked up the air and it danced to the clink of ice cubes soaked in distilled liver-piercing fluids.
- Barcelona Big Blues Band - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/projects/barcelona-big-blues-band/
  Traditionally, Barcelona has been presenting great jazz and swing Big Bands for many years.
- Barcelona Gipsy balKan Orchestra - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/projects/barcelona-gipsy-balkan-orchestra/
  Starting from November 2015, BGKO evolves: after so much intense work and growth, we are responding to the urge to expand our artistic horizons.
- Bernat Font Trio - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/projects/bernat-font-trio/
  In February of 2009 the trio of Bernat Font went on stage for the first time.
- Bratia - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/projects/bratia/
  Bratia, the Barcelona-based band, was born from the need of the Serbian double bassist settled in Barcelona, Ivan Kovacevic , to bring two musical worlds…
- Down Home - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/projects/down-home/
  Genre neo swing, crazy bluesin’, shaky rhythm, groovy boogie Lineup Hernán Senra (Chino): dobro and vocals\\ Duska Miscevic, alto sax\\ Pol Prats: tenor sax\\…
- Lazy Jumpers - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/projects/lazy-jumpers/
  Lazy Jumpers is a Blues and Rhythm & Blues quartet based in Barcelona, internationally recognised as one of today's finest Blues and Rhythm & Blues bands.
- Los Mambo Jambo - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/projects/los-mambo-jambo/
  Los Mambo Jambo is the instrumental band that created the 'Sonido Jambofónico', a wild blend of rock & roll, rhythm & blues, surf and swing performed from a…
- The Nu Niles - https://ivankovacevic.com/en/projects/the-nu-niles/
  The Nu Niles formed in 1996 and since then they have never stopped making music.

## CA (ca)

### Biografia

### Projectes
- Ivan Kovačević 5 Spots - https://ivankovacevic.com/ca/projectes/5-spots/
  Hi havia un temps en què el jazz escopia foc per la boca, carregava de fum l'atmosfera i ballava amb el clink dels glaçons banyats en destil·lats que foradaven…
- Barcelona Big Blues Band - https://ivankovacevic.com/ca/projectes/barcelona-big-blues-band/
  Tradicionalment, Barcelona ha presentat grans big bands de jazz i swing durant molts anys.
- Barcelona Gipsy balKan Orchestra - https://ivankovacevic.com/ca/projectes/barcelona-gipsy-balkan-orchestra/
  Després de tres anys de concerts increïbles, trobades musicals inspiradores, nombroses gires i 21 països visitats, la BGKO evoluciona i, a partir del novembre…
- Bernat Font Trio - https://ivankovacevic.com/ca/projectes/bernat-font-trio/
  El trio de Bernat Font va fer la seva primera actuació el febrer del 2009.
- Bratia - https://ivankovacevic.com/ca/projectes/bratia/
  Bratia, la banda barcelonina, neix de la necessitat del contrabaixista serbi establert a Barcelona, Ivan Kovacevic , d'unir dos mons musicals en una trepidant…
- Down Home - https://ivankovacevic.com/ca/projectes/down-home/
  Gènere neo swing, crazy bluesin’, shaky rhythm, groovy boogie Formació Hernán Senra (Chino): dobro i veu\\ Duska Miscevic, saxo alt\\ Pol Prats: saxo tenor\\ Ivan…
- Lazy Jumpers - https://ivankovacevic.com/ca/projectes/lazy-jumpers/
  Lazy Jumpers és un quartet resident a Barcelona de blues i rhythm&blues reconegut internacionalment com una de les millors bandes de blues i rhythm&blues…
- Los Mambo Jambo - https://ivankovacevic.com/ca/projectes/los-mambo-jambo/
  Los Mambo Jambo és la banda instrumental creadora del 'Sonido Jambofónico', una barreja salvatge de rock&roll, rhythm&blues, surf i swing interpretada sota una…
- The Nu Niles - https://ivankovacevic.com/ca/projectes/the-nu-niles/
  The Nu Niles es van formar el 1996 i des d'aleshores no han parat de fer música.

## SR (sr)

### Biografija
- Biografija - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/biografija/
  Muzička karijera kontrabasiste Ivana Kovačevića: od Beograda do Barselone, balkanska muzika, džez i rhythm & blues.

### Projekti
- Ivan Kovačević 5 Spots - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/projekti/5-spots/
  Nekada je džez plamteo iz grla, ispunjavao atmosferu dimom i plesao uz zveket kockica u alkoholnim pićima koja su pržila jetru.
- Barcelona Big Blues Band - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/projekti/barcelona-big-blues-band/
  Tradicionalno, Barselona već dugi niz godina predstavlja sjajne big bendove džez i sving muzike.
- Barcelona Gipsy balKan Orchestra - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/projekti/barcelona-gipsy-balkan-orchestra/
  Nakon tri godine neverovatnih koncerata, inspirativnih muzičkih susreta, brojnih turneja i 21 posećene zemlje, BGKO evoluira i od novembra 2015.
- Bernat Font Trio - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/projekti/bernat-font-trio/
  Trio Bernat Font odigrao je svoj prvi koncert u februaru 2009.
- Bratia - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/projekti/bratia/
  Bratia, barselonski bend, nastao je iz potrebe srpskog kontrabasiste koji živi u Barseloni, Ivan Kovačević , da spoji dva muzička sveta u uzbudljivu celinu.
- Down Home - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/projekti/down-home/
  Žanr neo swing, crazy bluesin’, shaky rhythm, groovy boogie Sastav Hernán Senra (Chino): dobro i vokal Duška Miščević: alto saksofon Pol Prats: tenor saksofon…
- Lazy Jumpers - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/projekti/lazy-jumpers/
  Lazy Jumpers je kvartet iz Barselone koji svira blues i rhythm&blues, međunarodno priznat kao jedan od najboljih aktuelnih blues i rhythm&blues bendova.
- Los Mambo Jambo - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/projekti/los-mambo-jambo/
  Los Mambo Jambo je instrumentalni bend koji je stvorio \"Jambofonski zvuk\" - divlju mešavinu rock&roll-a, rhythm&blues-a, surf-a i svinga interpretiranu kroz…
- The Nu Niles - https://ivankovacevic.com/sr/projekti/the-nu-niles/
  The Nu Niles formirani su 1996. Ivan Kovačević on double bass.
